verifications.claim: Artemis II is NASA's first crewed mission of the Artemis program
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The first crewed test flight under NASA’s Artemis program'; R3: 'Artemis II will be the first crewed mission of the Artemis programme'; R5: 'The first crewed Artemis flight'; R6: 'first crewed mission — of NASA’s Artemis program'; R7: 'first crewed mission of the agency's Artemis program'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state Artemis II as the first crewed mission in the Artemis program.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is scheduled to fly four astronauts around the Moon
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Four Artemis II astronauts are flying ... around the Moon'; R3: 'carrying four astronauts on a journey around the Moon'; R6: 'four astronauts will launch on a mission to the vicinity of the Moon'; R7: 'A crew of four astronauts undertook a 10-day mission around the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements confirm four astronauts flying around the Moon.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is a 10-day test flight
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'approximately 10-day journey'; R3: 'Duration: 10 days'; R4: 'TEN DAY JOURNEY'; R6: 'The 10-day Artemis II mission'; R7: '10-day mission'
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly describe it as a 10-day mission and test flight.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is to validate the Orion spacecraft and SLS rocket systems
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'test how the spacecraft’s systems operate ... demonstrating a broad range of SLS ... and Orion capabilities'; R6: 'test flight of ... the SLS rocket, and the Orion spacecraft'; R7: 'demonstrate key systems ... SLS rocket, and its crew capsule, Orion'
verifications.reasoning: References directly mention testing and validating Orion and SLS systems.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first human lunar flyby since 1972
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R5: 'NASA’s First Crewed Lunar Flyby in 50 Years'; R6: 'for the first time in over 50 years'; R7: 'first humans back to the Moon in over 50 years'; R1: references Apollo 13 (1970) distance record
verifications.reasoning: References support first crewed lunar mission/flyby in ~50+ years (approximating since ~1972 Apollo 17), but no exact 'since 1972'; Apollo 13 (1970) noted as prior record.

verifications.claim: The mission goal of Artemis II is to test the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems with a crew on board
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'evaluate Orion’s life-support'; 'verify Orion’s life support systems can sustain astronauts'; R3: 'life support systems to keep the crew safe'; R6: 'flight test Orion’s life-support systems with astronauts on board'; R7: 'life-support and environmental systems'
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation of testing life-support systems with crew aboard.
